name: @qa-portal/shell
description: Workspace shell -- the host application. Owns app chrome (sidebar/topbar, components/Layout.tsx), the cross-cutting pages that don't belong to one domain module (Login, Command Centre dashboard, QA Request gateway), and the Module Federation host config that loads the 4 domain modules (Functional/Security/Specialised Testing/Governance) as separately-built, separately-deployed remotes at runtime -- see vite.config.ts.
